name: saywise-skills
description: Show how you actually use AI. Turns your AI conversations and projects into AI Work story drafts for your Saywise profile — written in your voice — and backs your AI Stack with measured usage numbers (aggregate counts only, nothing from your conversations). Everything composes locally and is shown to you; drafts land private on your profile and you accept each one before it publishes ("don't submit" always wins), stats submit only when you say so. Hooks quietly queue story-worthy sessions as you close them; unattended drafting is opt-in and never transmits.
